name: HEIC to JPG
tagline: Turn iPhone HEIC photos into JPG or PNG that open anywhere.
seoTitle: Convert HEIC to JPG without uploading
description: Convert HEIC and HEIF photos from an iPhone to JPG or PNG for free, in your browser, one or many at once. Your photos never leave your device.

specs.Engine: libheif 1.22 (LGPL-3.0) compiled to WebAssembly, packaged by heic-to
specs.Safari: Uses the browser's own HEIC decoder, with no download
specs.First load: About 3 MB in other browsers, then cached
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: No. They're decoded and re-encoded inside this tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere. Once the page has loaded you can go offline and it still works.

faq.q: Why won't some HEIC files open?
faq.a: The decoder handles the still photos an iPhone takes. It can't open HEIC files that hold a video, an image sequence or an unusual codec, and it can't open a file that was cut short in transfer. The row for that file says it couldn't be read; the others still convert.
A Live Photo is a still HEIC plus a short video. You get the still photo as a JPG or PNG. The video part is a separate .mov file, which this tool leaves alone.
